content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. IITI/MATH/RA/02 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIT Indore notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: PhD in Mathematics with a very good publication record; Candidates who have submitted their PhD thesis are also eligible, provided they are suitable for the project Age limit: Maximum 35 years Other conditions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview Desirable: Very strong background in the analysis of Partial Differential Equations, especially Parabolic and hyperbolic evolution equations. Experience in the analysis of Navier-Stokes equations and related models will get preference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially for seven months (extendable depending on the availability of funds and the performance of the candidate)

content_sections.heading: How Will IIT Indore Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on CV and qualifications Interview of shortlisted candidates Online interview

content_sections.text: CV Essential Qualification Degree Certificates Marks Sheets Qualifying certificates Date of Birth Proof Certificate

content_sections.text: Fill in the form and attach the documents listed above. Email it to [email protected] . Email it on or before 3 December 2026.

content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be informed by email
